newsitem.title: USA: Nebraska fed cattle not well established - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Nebraska fed cattle not well established - USDA.

text.p: Trading was slow on Tuesday morning, USDA said. Few sales slaughter steers firm, but not well established. No sales on slaughter heifers. Buyer inquiry fairly good, seller interest light at current bids of up to $102.00 per cwt on a dressed basis. Most cattle offered for sale at $104.00 or higher.
Live basis sales - Equivalent 3 percent shrink delivered and FOB, some FOB 4% shrink. Dressed basis delivered (paid on hot carcass weights)
Slaughter Steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1200-1250 lbs 65.00;
